opening.argument: The presentation is an instructional walkthrough of merge-mining profitability, beginning with a free tool for calculating mining-equipment results: “I'm going to show you a valuable tool and teach you how to properly run profitability numbers on mining equipment.” Viewers are then shown how to select an algorithm in the EMCD calculator, account for electricity costs, and interpret a worked estimate of $5.72 in daily profit, rather than a verified payout. Any move to the promoted pool is expressly conditional: “you can seamlessly switch to mining with them if the numbers look good.” The material also discloses affiliate compensation, warns that crypto mining and investing are risky, and tells viewers to verify their equipment inputs and changing market conditions. Those qualifications frame the content as practical education and operational guidance, not a guaranteed-return claim.
